name: asp_honor
description: 分级荣誉及来源；当前佩戴不替代历史获得记录

columns.name: id
columns.description: 稳定编号

columns.name: tenant_id
columns.description: 组织管理范围

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: 来源赛事

columns.name: registration_id
columns.description: 获奖报名。同一 award_key 的个人证明行属于这一条报名获奖事实

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: 个人获得者

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: 队伍获得者

columns.name: award_key
columns.description: 同一条报名获奖事实的编号。双打和团体的多行个人证明共用

columns.name: category
columns.description: 独立业务状态；合法值不等于业务已获批准：official event achievement self_reported

columns.name: title
columns.description: 含项目、届次、层级和范围的名称

columns.name: source
columns.description: 授予或公布主体、证据和实际获奖成员快照；必须按版本校验结构

columns.name: status
columns.description: 独立业务状态；合法值不等于业务已获批准：pending verified suspended revised revoked

columns.name: awarded_at
columns.description: 获得时间；有时区业务时间

columns.name: display_until
columns.description: 当前展示期限；有时区业务时间

columns.name: applicant_account_id
columns.description: 外部荣誉申请本人账号；旧赛事及成长荣誉为空

columns.name: certification_status
columns.description: 外部荣誉认证流程 draft submitted correction approved rejected revoked；历史荣誉为空

columns.name: certification_details
columns.description: 本人申请事实与私有honor-proof编号；只限本人及平台审核人

columns.name: verified_snapshot
columns.description: 审核人独立确认的真实年份赛事项目名次及公布依据；公开投影不含证明及审核隐私

columns.name: certification_history
columns.description: 追加的提交与审核快照，不覆写既有历史；只限本人及平台审核人

columns.name: certification_public
columns.description: 本人公开同意；仅审核通过且运动名片也公开时生效

columns.name: certification_worn
columns.description: 本人选择佩戴的已通过认证荣誉；每人每运动最多一项

columns.name: sport_id
columns.description: 所属运动；历史奖项可空

columns.name: title_code
columns.description: 成长称号规则编码；正式奖项可空

checks: (person_id IS NOT NULL) <> (team_id IS NOT NULL)

certification_status IS NULL OR (certification_status IN ('draft','submitted','correction','approved','rejected','revoked') AND applicant_account_id IS NOT NULL AND person_id IS NOT NULL AND team_id IS NULL AND category = 'self_reported' AND sport_id IS NOT NULL AND ((certification_status = 'approved' AND status = 'verified' AND verified_snapshot <> '{}'::jsonb) OR (certification_status = 'revoked' AND status = 'revoked') OR (certification_status IN ('draft','submitted','correction','rejected') AND status = 'pending')))
unique: registration_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'verified'
responsibility: 应用服务执行状态转换、授权和跨记录一致性，数据库约束只是结构防线。
